auth.peer.evidence: An in-process pair for tests: the far end is whoever holds the other object. Declined so that Resolve-HordeLinkTransport, which requires auth.peer, never picks it (test/test-transport-conformance.ps1).

encrypt.evidence: Byte arrays passed between threads of one process.

dial.out.evidence: A node-role Open round-trips frames in test/test-transport-conformance.ps1.

dial.in.evidence: A hub-role Open round-trips frames in test/test-transport-conformance.ps1.

keepalive.evidence: Closing one end marks the other's inbound direction closed at once, and health reads closed with no frame sent (test/test-transport-conformance.ps1).

survives.peer.restart.evidence: A restarted listener hands out new pairs; the old link reads closed (test/test-transport-conformance.ps1).
